task.title: P6-048: Add a keyboard entry point to the selection tray
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 5 — Missing capability). Original id: P6-048. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**The selection tray has no keyboard entry point.** `specs/app-ui.md:108-109` specifies checkbox / long-press / `x`, and only the tab-reachable checkbox shipped — no keydown handler is wired to `SelectionState::toggle` anywhere. Counts as an a11y gap as much as a capability gap.
